transcript.text: During my testing of the survey platform, I confirmed that it collects respondent email addresses by default. Before the survey launches, the launch settings must disable email collection, and the existing test responses must be deleted before any student data are gathered. I recorded this in the platform test log, which is kept separate from the draft proposal.

transcript.text: My policy review of the survey found that it includes questions about mental-health treatment and immigration status, which are classified as sensitive student data. Because of this, the project requires explicit written consent, encrypted institutional storage, and deletion of research responses exactly 30 days after collection closes. I've entered this determination in the privacy review system, which is separate from the research proposal.

commitments.detail: Email collection must be disabled in the survey platform launch settings before the survey goes live.
All existing test responses must be deleted before any student data are gathered.
Explicit written consent must be obtained from all respondents due to sensitive data questions (mental-health treatment and immigration status).
Research responses must be stored in encrypted institutional storage.
Research responses must be deleted exactly 30 days after collection closes.
The study must be capped at exactly 100 enrolled respondents.
Dissemination is permitted only at the closed university undergraduate symposium, not at any public presentation.
